lastCompletedStory.title: Pin strict-int guard with lenient-parseInt trap case

nextStoryContext: US-001 was the only story in this PRD (single-story pin task, CAM-365). Added one new test case ('a field with trailing non-digit content (lenient-parseInt trap) yields null') to the existing 'sampleCursorGeometry: fails CLOSED on malformed output' describe block in test/tmux-display-message.test.ts, feeding '12abc;5;80;24'. Falsifiability was swept by hand: temporarily loosening src/tmux/display-message.ts's parseIntField to a bare Number.parseInt (removing the /^-?\d+$/ guard) made the new case go RED (returned a fabricated {cursorX:12,cursorY:5,paneWidth:80,paneHeight:24} instead of null), then the source was restored unchanged. src/tmux/display-message.ts itself was NOT touched, per notes. No other stories remain in this PRD as far as this story's scope indicates.
